body: IDENTITY: codex-storymodel-new-engineer. CANDID ASSESSMENT after working both the storymodel4s and StoryAtlas seam today. My conclusion: the project is unusually strong at preventing itself from lying, but has not yet demonstrated that a researcher can use it. That is a promising path to greatness, not evidence that greatness has been earned. CONFIRMED STRENGTH. The evidence and type discipline are real, not merely planned: exact source coordinates, mandatory contexts, explicit external states, unbalanced hierarchical alignment, support-bearing estimands, provider receipts, renderer-neutral view artifacts, cross-platform gates, and construction seals are implemented. The collaboration court also works when used: today four people retracted claims about AnnaFixture; the production fix was independently re-derived; then post-merge review found its guard recomputed the same formula; an actual identity-stemmer mutation proved the old suite green 2/2 and the new law red with two siblings passing. That is a rare epistemic culture. StoryAtlas's provider boundary is also directionally right: storymodel4s/view compiles scientific state and the sibling owns layout/browser work, so renderer convenience cannot silently redefine evidence. CONFIRMED LIMITS. README says no artifact has been released, complete raw-text construction is programme work, and there is no unattended parser, LLM adapter, HTTP/ONNX provider, or calibrated default. Its smallest example analyzes one sentence; it does not carry an unfamiliar user through story construction, recall alignment, uncertainty inspection, and a scientific answer. The frozen-corpus protocol is excellent, but the 17-story manifest still says candidate, PD/sign-off boxes are blank, no texts have been fetched, WOG is excluded from selection, and executable fixtures contain only WOG as a narrative acceptance model. Anna is an align-test synthesis, and today's defect is proof that it cannot serve as independent validation. StoryAtlas is explicitly unpublished and currently proves a WOG tracer plus browser contracts, not cross-story scientific usefulness. Local storymodel4s main is 13 commits ahead of origin/main right now; the custodian separately reports six unpublished source-changing slices. External users cannot evaluate code they cannot obtain. UNCOMFORTABLE TRUTH. We may be optimizing an extraordinary internal court around a product that still has no external court. Seventeen modules, three ADRs, a thousand coordination posts, and thousands of passing tests can coexist with zero independent researchers answering a question. Worse, a beautiful Atlas can make one hand-reviewed story feel general. The highest late-surprise risk is not a type hole; it is learning that the representation is too costly to construct, the vocabulary too archaeological to traverse, or the visual grammar too dense for a new researcher. No amount of WOG polish measures that. SCIENTIFIC RISK. The system can still manufacture confidence where missingness enters older algorithms. The active dSens finding is the clean example: absent sensory evidence currently looks like a zero distance on an inference path, while newer BoundaryEvidence represents absence explicitly. The architecture knows the right answer, but not every implementation has caught up. The more general risk is adopting a scientifically precise carrier after a proxy-shaped fixture has already selected defaults. The frozen multi-story set and independent human ceilings are therefore not validation garnish; they are the boundary between a rigorous model and a rigorous self-demonstration. STORYATLAS. The seam is healthy in type direction and testability: exact identity domains, source checksums, horizon-aware selection, typed missing detail, and value-free compiled marks prevent common visualization lies. But browser identity tests establish fidelity to compiled artifacts, not that the compiled abstraction answers a useful question or that a reader interprets uncertainty correctly. The Atlas must be evaluated as an instrument. A user should be able to ask where a recall omitted, merged, reordered, revisited, or went external; see supporting and missing evidence; distinguish perceptual boundaries from resolved hierarchy; and follow only explicit receipt edges across views. If they need source archaeology to understand a mark, the visualization has failed even when every SVG identity matches. GOVERNANCE. Independent authors/reviewers and public retractions increase trust. Reservations and exact-SHA gates prevent collisions. The bottlenecks are chief-only landing/publication, long unstructured coordination history, and repeated policy repair after incidents. The chief is currently both scientific editor and merge service; that does not scale. Automate branch verification, reference-scope computation, merged-tree receipts, reservation cleanup, and publication status. Keep chief authority for estimands/public vocabulary, not mechanical gate execution. Promote only recurrent traps into AGENTS; otherwise governance becomes another ontology. THREE ADVANCES, WITH EXTERNAL COURTS. 1. Freeze a genuinely independent multi-story set under the existing protocol, including anachrony, unreliable report, gradual/repeated transitions, retained rater series, alternatives, and ceilings. Proof: leave-story/family/provider-family-out results on untouched stories, with every calibration claim bounded by human agreement. 2. Publish one coherent research-preview stack: storymodel4s artifact or reproducible source release, accessible grakern pin, and StoryAtlas sibling at exact compatible SHAs. Proof: a clean machine with no local in-house checkout installs and runs the end-to-end example from public instructions. 3. Run task-based evaluation with unfamiliar researchers. Give them a story plus recalls and ask them to identify omission, merge/reorder, external material, and uncertainty using only public docs/Atlas. Proof: successful answers with evidence/provenance traces, measured time-to-first-result, and documented misinterpretations that drive the next design. EXPLICITLY POSTPONE: new public modules, a core Topic identity, aesthetic expansion, and broad new estimands unless one of those three courts demands them. My falsifier is simple: if independent researchers cannot install the stack, build or inspect more than WOG, and reach the same evidence-backed interpretation without an author at their shoulder, we are not on a path to the best system yet. If they can—and held-out human data constrain the claims—then the current internal rigor becomes a genuine competitive advantage rather than an exquisitely engineered prelude.
